v4.9.076 - the photo stays (#352)

Two lines in the pull, both in the branch that protects frames holding unsent
work - which is, by definition, the frame you just photographed.

That branch reset the card back to its FIRST version and then skipped the code
that restores which version each card was showing. So: take a photo, the card
switches to it, the push goes, the pull comes straight back, and the card is on
version one - and with no crossCompare it falls all the way to the main frame.
Every time on a photo, because a photo always leaves unsent work; only sometimes
elsewhere, because an empty pull no longer rebuilds anything at all (#349).

The same rebuild also set sortMode: false, which is the other half - going to a
shooting order and being dropped back into 3x2.

The rule that chooses 3x2 when a project OPENS is untouched, as asked.
